title: Graph Serializations for Reasoning LLMs: A Study Across Knowledge Extraction and Structural Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22734v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The way a knowledge graph is serialized as text for inclusion into LLM context can substantially affect downstream LLM performance, with prior work reporting tens of percentage points variations across formats. However, existing studies consider only a limited set of representations and predate frontier reasoning models, which now offer stronger reasoning, instruction-following, and long-context capabilities. We evaluate 15 graph representation formats across nine frontier LLM configurations on ontology-based knowledge extraction and structural graph reasoning tasks. While knowledge extraction is relatively insensitive to different serialization formats, the choice of the optimal format for structural reasoning tasks significantly affects accuracy. We demonstrate that the optimal representation choice depends on model, query, and task and propose to approach graph serialization as a dynamic orchestration decision.

translated_title: 面向推理大语言模型的图序列化：跨知识抽取与结构推理的研究
translated_abstract: 知识图谱被序列化为文本并纳入大语言模型上下文的方式会显著影响下游LLM的性能，先前的研究报告称不同格式之间存在数十个百分点的性能差异。然而，现有研究仅考虑了有限的一组表示形式，且早于前沿推理模型的出现——如今的前沿推理模型具备更强的推理、指令遵循和长上下文能力。我们在基于本体的知识抽取和结构图推理任务上，评估了15种图表示格式在九种前沿LLM配置下的表现。研究表明，知识抽取对不同的序列化格式相对不敏感，但在结构推理任务中，最优格式的选择会显著影响准确率。我们证明了最优表示的选择取决于模型、查询和任务，并提出应将图序列化视为一种动态编排决策。
tldr: 该论文在九种前沿推理LLM上评估了15种图序列化格式，发现知识抽取对格式不敏感，而结构推理的最优格式取决于模型、查询和任务，并提出将图序列化作为一种动态编排决策来处理。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates 15 graph serialization formats across nine frontier reasoning LLMs, showing that while knowledge extraction is relatively format-insensitive, the optimal format for structural reasoning depends on the model, query, and task, proposing graph serialization as a dynamic orchestration decision.
